cc:Work.dc:title: Rust versus Node session throughput
cc:Work.dc:description: Paired purchase-and-deploy games, engine seeds 42 and 99, three runs of ten episodes each. Includes reset and public observations. Native PyO3 JSON session versus warm persistent Node Match JSON bridge, recorded 2026-11-09. Decisions/second: Amiya Node 403.3590 Rust 532.8737; Sarkaz Node 279.2817 Rust 380.1633; Chen Node 450.6914 Rust 594.6902. Source round5-inline-node-comparison-20261109.json.
